title: Month Rate by Premium Band on a Lockout Balance
content:
# Month Rate by Premium Band on a Lockout Balance

Premium band rate sheet — Medicaid Managed Care Membership, lockout balances of CHIP memberships ended for unpaid premiums.

The month rate follows the premium band the household income on file sets: a household at or below the first band top percent of the federal poverty level owes the first band monthly amount for each owed month, a household above it and at or below the second band top percent owes the second band monthly amount, and any other household owes the amount of the most recent bill.

## Band sheet

| Household income on file (percent of the federal poverty level) | Month rate for each owed month |
|---|---|
| at or below 185% (first band top) | $20.00 (first band monthly amount) |
| above 185% and at or below 210% (second band top) | $35.00 (second band monthly amount) |
| above 210% | the amount of the most recent bill |

The household income is the whole percent of the federal poverty level on file on the membership. The most recent bill is the bill posted most recently on the premium account.

## Band edges (hypothetical incomes)

| Hypothetical income on file | Band | Month rate |
|---|---|---|
| 185% | first band | $20.00 |
| 186% | second band | $35.00 |
| 210% | second band | $35.00 |
| 211% | neither | the most recent bill, whatever its amount |

## Worked figure (hypothetical)

*Hypothetical:* 3 owed months, household income on file 190%, most recent bill $50.00. The household is above 185% and at or below 210%, so each owed month is rated at $35.00 and the owed months come to 3 multiplied by $35.00, which is $105.00.
